assumptions: Eligibility, notice, awareness, capability, action, inspection, violation, sanction, and outcome remain distinct.

constraints.description: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: regulatory operations director and behavioral insights lead
decision_question: Where should non-enforcement assistance, document, inspection, and technical services reduce verified barriers?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for compliance assistance and technical-support locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: access, privacy, language, neutrality, skill, and capacity-aware siting
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible cases beyond usable qualified assistance

intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting compliance assistance and technical-support locations, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible cases beyond usable qualified assistance
distributional gap in eligible cases beyond usable qualified assistance
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a candidate assistance site trusted, neutral, accessible, qualified, or used.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for compliance assistance and technical-support locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
